title: Produce phoneme/digraph audio assets + gesture playback
description: C2 / adversarial #11 (highest impl risk). Recorded/sourced audio for 44 phonemes + digraphs (sh/ch/th/wh/ck/ng/qu/ll/ss/ff/zz/ph); TTS fallback for words/sentences. Gesture-initiated playback; device QA on iPadOS Safari + desktop/mobile Chrome/Safari. Strategy: see ADR-002. Wire into content/audio/manifest.json.
acceptance_criteria: Phoneme/digraph audio present and referenced by the manifest; words/sentences fall back to TTS; playback is gesture-initiated; verified on target devices.

title: Author Phase A content manifest (binary AC11 anchor)

Define content/manifest.json declaring Phase A target counts (phonics skills, heart words, decodable words, fluency sentences, audio coverage) and extend scripts/content-validate.ts with a manifest-count check (AC12). Detailed in plan 002e.
acceptance_criteria: content/manifest.json declares Phase A counts; content-validate enforces them; AC11 becomes pass/fail.

title: Email: implement resend magic-link issuer

TDD: new magic-link.test.ts covering dev-log/resend-success/resend-failure/missing-config via cloudflare:test fetchMock.
acceptance_criteria: resend issuer sends branded email and returns echoable=false on 2xx; throws on non-2xx and on missing config; dev-log unchanged; full api suite green.

title: Email: widen issuer env typings for resend

title: v1.0 content bar

title: Transactional email provider (Resend)
